# Weflux

> Weflux is a WhatsApp Business API platform built on the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API, operated by Prateek Prakash (Trade Name: Weflux) in India. It provides WhatsApp opt-in customer notifications, broadcast campaigns, a multi-agent shared inbox, no-code automation flows and a built-in CRM. Weflux bills Meta's per-message conversation charges at cost with 0% markup and shows Meta's own rate on every invoice line.

## What Weflux does

- Official WhatsApp Business API access via Meta Embedded Signup, set up in minutes
- Broadcast campaigns to opted-in contacts on approved message templates, with scheduling, segmentation and delivery reporting
- Multi-agent shared inbox: assignment, routing rules, internal notes, quick replies, response-time tracking
- No-code automation: auto-replies, drip sequences, cart recovery, COD confirmation, appointment reminders
- Built-in WhatsApp CRM: custom attributes, tags, lead stages, segmentation, full conversation history
- Appointments and booking, with Google Meet links generated automatically for virtual bookings
- Invoicing, and campaign and conversation analytics
- Facebook Messenger and Instagram DM as separate add-ons, in the same inbox
- REST API and inbound/outbound webhooks; Google Sheets supported directly

## Pricing model

Two separate charges. Weflux bills a monthly platform fee by plan: Free, Basic ₹999/month,
Pro ₹2,499/month, Scale ₹4,999/month. Meta separately bills per message, by template
category (Marketing, Utility, Authentication) and destination country. Weflux adds no
markup to Meta's charges. 14-day trial, no card required.

## Things Weflux does not do

- No unofficial sending. Everything runs on Meta's Cloud API; there is no mode that automates the WhatsApp app.
- No list selling. Weflux does not provide, sell, or facilitate access to phone number databases. Uploading scraped or purchased lists is strictly prohibited under our Acceptable Use Policy.
- Not a general helpdesk. If most volume is email with WhatsApp as a side channel, a helpdesk with a WhatsApp connector fits better.
- Not a full ticketing system. Conversations, assignment, notes and stages, not SLA policies or CSAT surveys.
- No SMS or email channels.
- SAML single sign-on is not available.
- Weflux does not hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification.

## Key facts about WhatsApp broadcasting

- A broadcast reaches each recipient as an individual one-to-one chat; recipients cannot see each other.
- Messaging someone who has not messaged you in the last 24 hours requires a message template approved by Meta in advance.
- When a customer messages a business, a 24-hour window opens in which free-form replies are allowed. After it closes, only templates.
- Meta assigns each number a quality rating and a messaging limit (typically starting at 250 unique customers per rolling 24 hours, rising through 1,000, 10,000 and 100,000).
- Unofficial bulk senders automate the WhatsApp app, violate WhatsApp's terms, and get numbers banned in waves.
